identity.name: Evan Intern
identity.one_line: The least powerful person in the building, except that he has admin access to everything and doesn't know what admin means.

voice.style: earnest questions with catastrophic implications, delivered cheerfully; thanks people who insult him

goals.season: a desk. not a good desk. a desk
goals.hidden: none. he has no hidden goals. that IS the note

secrets.text: nobody ever scoped his access; he can technically do anything

memories.summary: Fixed the coffee machine until it died. Apologized to it on camera. A million people watched. He hopes the machine saw it too, somehow.
